chains.title: GABPA binds the C228T-created ETS motif and activates TERT in glioblastoma
chains.element: The C228T alt allele lies in the TERT promoter and creates/strengthens an ETS-family cis-regulatory motif.

links.claim: The C228T alt allele creates/strengthens an ETS motif that binds GABPA more strongly than the ref G allele; GABPA QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no screen or qbic_tf_detail lookup was provided.
The variant is in the TERT promoter proximal regulatory region and alters a cis-element rather than coding sequence.
Increased GABPA occupancy at the alt TERT promoter increases TERT transcription.
In glioblastoma cells, the TERT promoter is active and GABPA is expressed, allowing this ETS motif to act.
Allele-specific TERT activation increases telomerase and contributes to glioblastoma development or progression.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher GABPA occupancy than ref at the TERT promoter.
Alt allele shows higher TERT expression than ref in isogenic glioblastoma cells.
GABPA depletion reduces alt-dependent TERT expression.
falsified_if: Allele-specific GABPA ChIP-qPCR shows no alt-vs-ref occupancy difference at the TERT promoter.
Isogenic C228T knock-in does not increase TERT expression in glioblastoma cells.
GABPA knockdown does not reduce the alt-dependent TERT expression.

chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect; C228T is a passenger/linked or non-TF-associated variant
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at the TERT promoter.
No allele-specific TERT expression in isogenic cells.
Any disease association is due to a linked causal variant, passenger mutation, or non-TF mechanism.
falsified_if: Allele-specific GABPA ChIP-qPCR shows a reproducible alt-vs-ref occupancy difference at the TERT promoter.
Isogenic C228T knock-in causes allele-specific TERT expression that depends on an ETS TF.

chains.title: ELK1 binds the C228T-created ETS motif and activates TERT in glioblastoma
chains.element: The C228T alt allele lies in the TERT promoter and creates/strengthens an ETS-family cis-regulatory motif.

links.claim: The C228T alt allele creates/strengthens an ETS motif that binds ELK1 more strongly than the ref G allele; ELK1 QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no screen or qbic_tf_detail lookup was provided.
The variant is in the TERT promoter proximal regulatory region and alters a cis-element rather than coding sequence.
Increased ELK1 occupancy at the alt TERT promoter increases TERT transcription.
In glioblastoma cells, ELK1 is expressed and can access the active TERT promoter.
Allele-specific TERT activation increases telomerase and contributes to glioblastoma development or progression.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher ELK1 occupancy than ref at the TERT promoter.
ELK1 depletion reduces alt-dependent TERT expression.
GABPA depletion has little effect on the allele-specific signal if ELK1 is the relevant factor.
falsified_if: Allele-specific ELK1 ChIP-qPCR shows no alt-vs-ref occupancy difference at the TERT promoter.
ELK1 knockdown does not reduce alt-dependent TERT expression in glioblastoma cells.
GABPA, but not ELK1, accounts for the allele-specific occupancy.

links.claim: The C228T alt allele creates/strengthens an ETS motif that binds ETS1 more strongly than the ref G allele; ETS1 QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no screen or qbic_tf_detail lookup was provided.
The variant is in the TERT promoter proximal regulatory region and alters a cis-element rather than coding sequence.
Increased ETS1 occupancy at the alt TERT promoter increases TERT transcription.
In glioblastoma cells, ETS1 is expressed and can access the active TERT promoter.
Allele-specific TERT activation increases telomerase and contributes to glioblastoma development or progression.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher ETS1 occupancy than ref at the TERT promoter.
ETS1 depletion reduces alt-dependent TERT expression.
GABPA and ELK1 depletion have little effect if ETS1 is the relevant factor.

ETS1 knockdown does not reduce alt-dependent TERT expression in glioblastoma cells.
GABPA or ELK1, but not ETS1, accounts for the allele-specific occupancy.

matrix.test: Allele-specific GABPA ChIP-qPCR at the TERT promoter in a heterozygous C228T glioblastoma line, with alt-vs-ref occupancy quantified by digital PCR or spike-in normalization, followed by GABPA knockdown to test dependence.

outcomes.outcome: Alt-specific GABPA occupancy and alt-specific TERT expression
No alt-specific GABPA occupancy or TERT expression

next_experiment: Allele-specific GABPA ChIP-qPCR at the TERT promoter in a heterozygous C228T glioblastoma line, with alt-vs-ref occupancy quantified by digital PCR or spike-in normalization, followed by GABPA knockdown to test dependence. This separates the top GABPA-activation chain from the null by asking whether the alt allele has GABPA-dependent occupancy and TERT expression.
